description.message: Let AI agents use your real, logged-in Chrome. No debugger banner, no tab to keep open.

code_help.message: Paste it into the program that drives your agents (Claude Code, Cursor, your own app). Whoever holds it can act in this browser: keep it private.

new_code_help.message: The old code stops working at once.

server_help.message: The public one is free. You can run your own from the repository.

welcome_text.message: Agents act in your Chrome through the connection code below. Their tabs open in this window, in their own tab group.

script_hint.message: To let agents run code in pages, turn on "Allow user scripts" in this extension's details.
